resolved.title: Update 更新数据
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Updating Data[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]UPDATE [/b]statement allows us to alter data in the table. 

[s0l0!-header]The basic syntax of an [b]UPDATE[/b] query with a [b]WHERE[/b] clause is as follows:[/s0l0!-header][code format="sql" ][b]UPDATE [/b]table_name
[b]SET [/b]column1=value1, column2=value2, ...
WHERE condition;[/code]
You specify the column and its new value in a comma-separated list after the [b]SET [/b]keyword.
[note]If you omit the WHERE clause, [b]all[/b] records in the table will be updated![/note]

WHERE condition;[/code]

[s0l0!-header][h1]Updating Multiple Columns[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

It is also possible to UPDATE [b]multiple columns[/b] at the same time by comma-separating them:[code format="sql" codeId="3073"]UPDATE Employees 
SET Salary=5000, FirstName='Robert'
WHERE ID=1;[/code]

resolved.title: Delete 删除数据
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Deleting Data[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]DELETE [/b]statement is used to remove data from your table. DELETE queries work much like UPDATE queries.[code format="sql" ]DELETE FROM table_name
WHERE condition; [/code]
For example, you can delete a specific employee from the table: [code format="sql" codeId="3074"]DELETE FROM Employees
WHERE ID=1;[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result: [/b][/s0l0!-header][img id="2850" width="100%"]
[note]If you omit the WHERE clause, [b]all [/b]records in the table will be deleted!
The DELETE statement removes the data from the table permanently.[/note]

resolved.title: 超市过期商品清理
resolved.problem_statement_md:
下图给定一个超市的商品表**products**，显示了每个商品的字段：

![](/content/assets/ef077654a7f4df764554.jpeg)

列字段含义:
- `id`: 商品ID
- `name`: 商品名
- `category`: 类别
- `price`: 价钱
- `expiredate`: 剩余过期天数

现在你需要处理掉所有过期的产品。

从**products**表中**删除**所有`expiredate`小于1的商品，并查询没有任何过期商品。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Deleting Data[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are manager in the supermarket.
Here is the [b]products[/b] table showing a field for each item, along with the ExpireDate with the count of days remaining before item expiration. [img id="4521" width="100%"]
You need to get rid of all the expired products.
[b]Delete [/b]from the ‘products’ table all of the items whose 'ExpireDate' is less than 1 and show the table without any expired items.
[note]The [b]DELETE[/b] statement removes the data from the table permanently.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: **DELETE**语句将数据从表中永久地删除。
